raw.description:
Do you have a proven track record of originating and closing high-value commercial deals within the creative industries? Do you understand the full creative economy value chain - from talent development and content creation to distribution and monetisation — and where the biggest opportunities for growth are emerging today?

Are you energised by the rapid evolution of the creative sector, particularly the rise of the creator economy and the transformative impact of AI on how content is produced, scaled, and monetised? Do you see the opportunity to build sustainable revenue models that unlock both commercial value and real pathways for creative talent?

Are you equally strong at building relationships as you are at delivering them — able to secure strategic partnerships, manage complex stakeholders, and ensure world-class execution that drives long-term impact?

If you’re excited by the opportunity to help shape and scale one of the most dynamic and fast-growing sectors on the continent — and to play a role in unlocking Africa’s creative potential at scale — then this might just be the role for you.

About ALX Africa

ALX Africa, a non-profit organisation under the ALX Foundation, is dedicated to unlocking the potential of Africa's digital future. Formerly part of Sand Tech Holdings, we've embarked on an independent journey to provide world-class tech skills training and career acceleration programmes. Our mission is to bridge the digital divide, upskill and reskill talent, and create a generation of innovative leaders. By 2030, we aim to empower 2 million Africans to secure sustainable tech careers.

With hubs in 8 cities across Africa and counting, we provide safe access to quality learning and a dedicated network of expert instructors. Our innovative programmes equip learners with the practical skills and knowledge needed to succeed in today's rapidly evolving tech industry. Through a combination of rigorous coursework, industry partnerships, and hands-on projects, we prepare our students for in-demand roles in software engineering, data science, and cybersecurity.

We achieve this by:

  • Providing young professionals with access to the most in-demand tech skills that will power the future.
  • Empowering the next generation of technology innovators, entrepreneurs, and business leaders through challenging, real-world coursework.
  • Building a lifelong, impactful community of tech professionals that support them at all stages of their career journey.

Our impact thus far:

  • 347k+ graduates since 2020
  • 257k youth in work
  • 31k youth starting own ventures
  • 60k youth in jobs created by entrepreneurs

Visit our website www.alxafrica.com to learn more about our digital revolution.

Role Summary: ALX Africa is seeking a senior Business Development Specialist to drive revenue growth across our Creative Economy initiatives, with a specific focus on capacity building and IP monetization opportunities.

This role is designed for a seasoned commercial leader with a proven track record of securing grant funding, corporate training partnerships, and large-scale upskilling programmes, alongside unlocking opportunities within the creator and creative industries ecosystem.

The successful candidate will have a strong understanding of where demand exists in the current market — from development finance and donor-funded programmes, to corporate capability building, to creator economy upskilling pipelines — and the ability to translate these into structured, revenue-generating partnerships.

In parallel, the role will support the growth of our media and content production company, identifying opportunities for production, branded content, and industry collaborations that create both commercial value and real-world opportunities for ALX talent.

This is a hybrid role spanning business development, partnership structuring, and account leadership, requiring someone who can originate deals and ensure they are delivered with excellence.

Specific Responsibilities

  • Identify, develop, and secure revenue opportunities within the creative sector, spanning:

    • Grant-funded capacity building programmes (DFIs, foundations, public sector)
    • Corporate training and creative talent development partnerships
    • Creator economy and industry-led upskilling initiatives
  • Lead the end-to-end deal lifecycle — from opportunity origination and proposal development to commercial structuring and contract negotiation.
  • Position ALX as a leading capacity building provider for creative, digital talent, translating market demand into scalable, revenue-generating programmes.
  • Build and manage a strong, strategic pipeline aligned to ALX’s Creative Economy priorities, with clear visibility on revenue opportunities and conversion.
  • Unlock and structure partnerships through our media and content production company, including branded content, production, and industry collaborations.
  • Own and grow key partner relationships, ensuring world-class client service, delivery excellence, and long-term account expansion.
    Collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure partnerships are executed effectively and deliver against both commercial and impact objectives.
  • Track and report on pipeline health, revenue performance, and partnership outcomes, providing insights to inform strategy.
  • Represent ALX across the creative industry, corporate, and donor ecosystem, strengthening our position as a partner of choice.

Skill Requirements - Essential

  • 5–10+ years of experience in business development, partnerships, or commercial strategy within the creative industries.
  • Proven track record of driving revenue growth through business development, including grants, corporate partnerships, and large-scale capacity-building or training programmes.
  • Strong understanding of the creative and digital talent ecosystem, with insight into emerging opportunities within the creator economy and the impact of AI on content creation, distribution, and monetisation models.
  • Demonstrated ability to originate, structure, and close complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
  • Experience in client relationship management and service delivery, with a track record of ensuring high-quality programme execution.
  • Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to translate market opportunities into scalable and sustainable revenue streams.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement, negotiation, and communication skills, with the ability to influence at a senior level.
  • Experience working across regional and/or global markets, with the ability to navigate diverse stakeholder environments.

Skill Requirements - Preferable

  • Experience working with development finance institutions (DFIs), donors, or grant funding ecosystems, particularly within the creative or youth employment sectors.

  • Established network across creative industries, media, and creator economy ecosystems (e.g. studios, platforms, agencies, collectives, or industry bodies).

  • Experience designing or scaling capacity-building, workforce development, or talent pipeline programmes within the creative sector.

  • Exposure to content production, media, or IP development, including an understanding of how creative outputs are commercialised and monetised.

  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to coordinate complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives and ensure high-quality delivery against timelines and objectives.

  • Familiarity with African and Global market dynamics, with experience working across multiple regions or countries on the continent.

  • Entrepreneurial or venture-building experience, particularly in creative, media, or platform-based businesses.

  • High level of AI tool fluency (e.g. ChatGPT, automation, workflow tools) to drive operational efficiency, proposal development, and deal execution.

Person Specification/Attributes

  • Courage: Willingness to speak up, challenge the status quo, and embrace new challenges.
  • Humility: Openness to learning, seeking help when needed, and a focus on serving others.
  • Adventure: A passion for setting ambitious goals, tackling difficult tasks, and finding joy in the journey.
  • Initiative: Proactive problem-solving, a sense of ownership, and a willingness to go above and beyond.
  • Resilience: The ability to bounce back from setbacks, persevere through challenges, and emerge stronger.
  • Commercial Acumen: Strong instinct for identifying opportunity, structuring deals, and driving revenue.
  • Relationship Intelligence: Builds trust quickly and sustains long-term, high-value partnerships.
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: A builder with a strong sense of ownership, comfortable operating in ambiguity and creating structure where it doesn’t exist.
  • Hustle & Bias for Action: Willing to roll up their sleeves, move quickly, and do what it takes to get deals across the line in a lean team environment.
  • Communication Excellence: Clear, compelling, and confident communicator — able to influence senior stakeholders, articulate complex ideas simply, and represent ALX with credibility across diverse audiences.

Employment Type

This role is a full-time position

Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

PMO Manager

As a PMO Manager, you will be the engine room of our transformation office. You will provide insight and transparency across the portfolio, translating into actionable next steps to ensure delivery against the plan. You will be responsible for ensuring that our portfolio is prioritized for maximum value, risks are mitigated before they become issues, and delivery remains on track.

Core Responsibilities

1. Transformation Insights & Executive Reporting

  • Data-Driven Storytelling: Transform complex project data into high-level executive reports that highlight progress, budget health, and strategic alignment.
  • Actionable Analysis: Move beyond "red/amber/green" status updates to provide deep-dive insights that help leadership make informed decisions.

2. Strategic Pipeline Management

  • Resource Optimization: Lead rigorous pipeline reviews with Initiative Owners (IOs) to ensure talent and capital are allocated to the highest-priority work.
  • Portfolio Balance: Maintain a balanced mix of "run," "grow," and "transform" initiatives, ensuring the organization isn't over-leveraged in any one area.

  • Quarterly/Half-Year Reviews: Lead formal performance audits for all initiatives scheduled for delivery, ensuring they meet strict quality and timeline standards.
  • Bottleneck Identification: Proactively identify dependencies and friction points across workstreams, facilitating cross-functional solutions to keep delivery on pace.

4. Risk Governance & Mitigation

  • L2 Risk Orchestration: Own the Level 2 (L2) risk log, chairing monthly reviews to ensure every threat has a robust, proactive mitigation strategy.
  • Escalation Management: Act as the primary filter for risk, escalating critical threats to senior leadership with clear recommendations for resolution.

5. Portfolio Management Excellence

  • Methodology Champion: Act as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for transformation best practices, coaching project leads on standardized methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid).
  • Continuous Improvement: Regularly evaluate PMO processes and tools to drive efficiency, automation, and better user adoption across the business.

Key Requirements

  • Experience: 5+ years in a PMO or Project Management leadership role, ideally within a large-scale transformation environment.

Position Summary

The Implementation & Training Specialist is responsible for the design and delivery of training programs, resources and learning experiences to support the launches and maintenance of Teladoc Health Canada’s Virtual Acute Care programs and the learning and professional development needs of the employees and providers supporting these clinical programs. Working closely with the Manager, Implementation & Training, organizational stakeholders, and subject matter experts, the Implementation & Training Specialist will ensure evidence-based clinical standards and best practices are reflected in training and development activities across the organization.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Develop materials used to facilitate learning for a clinical audience, including (but not limited to): e-learning assets; course outlines, objectives, and descriptions; instructional videos; workbooks; user guides; job aids; FAQs; learning activities; and PowerPoint presentations.

  • Deliver synchronous and asynchronous training to new and existing clinical staff and providers using a variety of mediums, including (but not limited to): lectures, workshops, videos, e-learning, demonstrations, and simulations; in both in-person and virtual environments.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders and subject matter experts across the organization to proactively assess and identify individual, departmental and organization clinical education needs.

  • Support the successful launch of new products, policies, partnerships, and pilot projects through the development of high-quality training assets for a clinical audience, in accordance with project deadlines.

  • Assesses client training requirements and adapts training delivery to the client’s organization needs.

  • Works with the product and technology teams to develop client training material for new features and functionality

  • Incorporates new releases awareness and training into the training curriculum

  • Supports operational team with ongoing training needs or delivery of client specific metrics

  • Identify specific training requirements, knowledge gaps and quality challenges, proposing and implementing solution

  • Work closely with the Learning & Development team with the development and delivery of foundational onboarding and role-specific training curriculums for clinical staff and providers, with an emphasis on patient safety, clinical quality, and applicable policies and practice guidelines.

  • Cultivate a smooth and positive onboarding and training experience for new and returning clinical staff and providers that promotes Teladoc’s goals, vision, and cultural value, including a commitment to clinical excellence and the highest standards in patient care.

  • Review and modify training content as needed to maintain an up-to-date training library that accurately reflects current operational processes, product/program enhancements, technological updates, and clinical best practices.

  • Seek to continuously improve and enhance training content and delivery methods based on learner and stakeholder feedback and evaluative data.

  • Other duties as assigned.

  • Clinical training, quality, and documentation experience

  • Telephonic clinical experience is a plus

  • Love of learning and ability to teach others

  • Effective communication skills (verbal and written), documentation skills, interpersonal skills, and problem-solving skills.

  • Proficient in using technology including software programs such as Microsoft Word, Outlook, Excel, Articulate 360, Storyline and Learning Management Systems

  • Ability to explain technical concepts confidently to non-technical clinical audiences; familiarity with medical and healthcare terminology

  • Ability to adapt to a fast-paced work environment in a growing company with expanding service lines and client base

  • Demonstrates organizational and assertiveness skills, flexibility, and the ability to work effectively in teams

Senior Product Designer

Location: Remote – Mainland USA
Department: Product Design
Reports to: Director, Product Design

Visa Sponsorship: Visa Sponsorship is not offered for this position.

Why Join Omnicell?

At Omnicell, we’re transforming medication management by building a unified, cloud‑based platform that connects automated dispensing cabinets, mobile workflows, and AI‑powered intelligence into a single, cohesive ecosystem. Our work directly impacts clinicians, pharmacists, and patients—helping healthcare teams work safer, faster, and smarter every day.

As a Senior Product Designer, you’ll design beyond screens. You’ll shape end‑to‑end journeys across cloud, mobile, and device experiences, partner deeply with product and engineering, and use AI‑assisted tools to move from insight to working prototype faster than traditional design processes allow. If you’re excited to replace static specs with interactive, testable solutions—and bring consumer‑grade usability to healthcare—this role was built for you.

What You’ll Do

Purpose: Own the full design arc—from discovery through validated, code‑backed prototypes—delivering outcomes that improve clinical workflows, product adoption, and business performance.

As a Senior Product Designer, you will:

Design, Drafting & Prototyping

  • Lead end‑to‑end journey design, accounting for system states, edge cases, error handling, and recovery paths—not just happy‑path screens.
  • Deliver interactive, high‑fidelity prototypes (using tools such as Figma Make, vibe‑coding environments, or equivalent) as the primary design artifact; static specifications are the exception.
  • Translate patterns and interactions from adjacent industries (fintech, retail, consumer tech) into healthcare‑appropriate solutions that meet regulatory and clinical constraints.
  • Contribute to and evolve Omnicell’s design system, including tokens, components, and usage guidelines across cloud, mobile, and device surfaces.

AI Integration & Innovation

  • Use AI daily as a design partner—for ideation, layout exploration, content generation, research synthesis, and code‑assisted prototyping.
  • Apply clear quality criteria to evaluate AI outputs, refining or rejecting suggestions based on user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Explore and prototype AI‑enabled experiences such as adaptive interfaces, intelligent workflows, and data‑driven recommendations.

Collaboration & Influence

  • Facilitate cross‑functional design sprints and workshops with Product Management, Engineering, and clinical subject‑matter experts.
  • Operate within durable product triads (Designer + PM + Engineering Lead), focused on shipping outcomes—not handoffs.
  • Influence decisions beyond your immediate team by clearly articulating trade‑offs, presenting rationale, and building alignment across stakeholders.

Customer Value & Discovery

  • Lead discovery and validation efforts through journey mapping, ethnographic research, and user interviews with pharmacists, clinicians, and operations teams.
  • Apply methods from service design, behavioral science, and operations research to deeply understand complex pharmacy and medication workflows.

Business Acumen

  • Tie design decisions to measurable outcomes such as adoption, task‑time reduction, NPS, and operational efficiency.
  • Monitor competitive and market trends to inform differentiation and platform‑level design strategy.

Mentorship & Craft Evolution

  • Coach peers through regular feedback, documented best practices, and shared craft playbooks that scale team impact.
  • Challenge assumptions, lead retrospectives, and drive process improvements when evidence calls for change.

Who You Are

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product design experience delivering complex, multi‑workflow systems in healthcare, enterprise SaaS, or similarly regulated domains.
  • A portfolio that emphasizes interactive prototypes, demonstrating end‑to‑end journeys, systems thinking, and measurable user or business impact.
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, including AI‑assisted capabilities (e.g., Figma Make), with comfort using code‑backed prototyping or vibe‑coding tools.
  • Proven experience integrating AI into your design workflow beyond copywriting—partnering with AI for research synthesis, strategic exploration, and prototyping.
  • Strong facilitation and storytelling skills, with the ability to present to leadership and influence cross‑functional teams without formal authority.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing across cloud, mobile, and hardware‑adjacent interfaces within a shared ecosystem.
  • Background in healthcare, clinical workflows, or regulated product environments.
  • Familiarity with service design or systems‑level design methodologies.
  • Education in design, HCI, psychology, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.

How You’ll Elevate at Omnicell

At Omnicell, success is defined not only by what you deliver, but how you deliver it. As a Senior Product Designer, you will:

  • Collaborate: Build trusted partnerships with product, engineering, and clinical teams to solve complex problems together.
  • Inspire: Elevate the quality of design thinking across teams through strong rationale, clear storytelling, and bold exploration.
  • Develop: Continuously grow your craft while actively mentoring others and contributing to shared standards.
  • Execute: Take ownership of outcomes, prioritize effectively, and move ideas from insight to shippable solutions.
  • Impact: Drive meaningful improvements in healthcare experiences by challenging assumptions and designing for real‑world use.

Department: Executive Leadership / Operations

About Us

Most law firm owners are brilliant attorneys but accidental entrepreneurs. They get trapped in an exhausting cycle of 60-hour workweeks, unpredictable cash flow, and zero scalability.

At How to Manage a Small Law Firm (HTM), we don't just give them generic business advice. We install a proven business model. We are a multi-time Inc. 5000 fastest-growing private company and recognized as a "Best Place to Work" because we practice exactly what we teach.

The Opportunity

We are not hiring a traditional, corporate COO to simply oversee existing red tape or manage middle management. We are seeking an elite operational architect to build empires.

As a Growth Partner & Fractional COO, you won't be siloed inside a single corporate department. You will step into the driver’s seat alongside multiple law firm owners simultaneously. You will serve as their operational backbone, their strategic second-in-command, and the executive leader who holds them ruthlessly accountable to their own massive growth potential.

What You Will Do (Responsibilities)

  • System Architecture: Design, build, and deploy scalable operational frameworks that turn chaotic small businesses into highly predictable, 7-figure enterprises.
  • Bottleneck Destruction: Conduct deep-dive operational diagnostics to immediately identify where profit is leaking, where workflow is stalling, and why the owner is bottlenecked.
  • Ruthless Accountability: Implement clear KPI dashboards. Teach owners and their teams to manage by hard data, not by feelings, excuses, or "intentions."
  • Fractional Leadership: Scale businesses ranging from $1M to $35M+ by acting as the execution-first leader who translates high-level vision into daily operational reality.

What You Bring (Requirements)

  • Direct Founder/Owner Fluency: You must have extensive, hands-on experience working directly with small-to-mid-sized business owners. You understand the unique psychology, speed, and challenges of an entrepreneurial founder and know how to guide them from vision to execution.
  • 12+ years of elite operational leadership experience as a COO, VP of Operations, or Head of Operations.
  • Proven success scaling small to mid-sized businesses ($1M–$35M+)—enterprise-only corporate backgrounds will not be a fit here.
  • A "Builder" mentality. You get energy from turning chaotic, fast-moving environments into smooth, predictable operations.
  • Strong founder psychology. You know how to collaborate with, advise, and firmly push back on passionate visionaries to execute a plan.
  • Execution-first approach. You focus heavily on driving measurable, bottom-line financial and operational results, rather than just delivering high-level strategy.

This Role Is NOT a Fit If:

  • You have only managed operations for large corporations, enterprise divisions, or boards of directors—if you haven't worked directly with the actual owner/founder of a small-to-mid-sized business, you will struggle here.
  • You prefer large corporate environments with pre-built, established infrastructure.
  • You focus primarily on strategy and want to hand off the actual execution to someone else.
  • You lack direct experience advising, coaching, or partnering closely with business owners.

Benefits & Perks

  • Unmatched Professional Variety: Transform dozens of entrepreneurial businesses simultaneously instead of optimizing just one.
  • High-Agency Culture: We value results over red tape. No micromanagement or useless meetings—just absolute autonomy to deliver world-class operational breakthroughs.
  • Leveraged Compensation: A competitive $110,000 base salary with a performance incentive structure bringing total earning potential to $182,000+, scaling directly with the growth you create.

If you’re tired of managing corporate red tape and ready to actually build something that matters, hit apply. Let’s see what you’ve got.

Salary: $110,000 – $182,000 / year

Storage Engineer

Job Title: Storage Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (Continental United States)
Position Type: In-house Bright Vision Technologies SOW engagement (no third-party client or vendor)
Experience: 5+ years
Salary Range : $100k to $150k per annnum
Sponsorship: No new H1B sponsorship available. H1B transfers welcomed for qualified candidates.

Engagement: Long-term, multi-year, aligned to the Bright Vision SOW delivery roadmap
Compensation: Competitive base salary commensurate with experience, plus benefits.

Employment Terms & Visa Policy
This is a 100% remote, full-time, direct W2 position with Bright Vision Technologies.
This role is part of Bright Vision Technologies’ in-house Statement of Work (SOW) engagement. The client, end customer, and employer for this position is Bright Vision Technologies — there is no third-party client, vendor, or implementation partner involved.
We do not engage in C2C, 1099, or third-party arrangements for this role.
BUT STRICTLY NO C2C/1099/3RD PARTY COMPANIES. ALL OUR ROLES ARE W2 AND NO 3RD PARTY BROKERING PLEASE.
Candidates must be willing to work directly as a full-time W2 employee of Bright Vision Technologies and contribute to our in-house SOW deliverables.

However, candidates who are currently on a valid H1B visa and require a transfer are welcome to apply. We will support H1B transfers for qualified candidates.
For every role, a technical coding assessment is mandatory. Please apply only if you are confident in your technical abilities and hands-on experience.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Storage Engineer with deep expertise across enterprise storage platforms — NetApp ONTAP, Pure Storage, and Ceph — to design, deploy, and operate the storage foundation that supports our compute, virtualization, database, and Kubernetes workloads. The role spans block, file, and object storage across data center, edge, and cloud environments, with strong attention to performance, data protection, and cost. The ideal candidate has operated heterogeneous storage estates at scale, understands the storage characteristics of diverse workloads, and brings strong automation discipline to storage engineering work.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design and operate enterprise storage platforms across NetApp ONTAP, Pure Storage FlashArray/FlashBlade, and Ceph.
  • Implement and manage SAN, NAS, and object storage across data center and cloud environments.
  • Build storage solutions for VMware, Kubernetes (CSI drivers), and database workloads.
  • Design and operate replication, snapshot, and backup strategies for critical data assets.
  • Implement and operate cloud-tiered storage with FabricPool, CloudVolumes, or equivalent.
  • Build storage automation using Ansible, Terraform, REST APIs, and platform-native automation.
  • Operate Ceph clusters including OSD lifecycle, CRUSH maps, RGW, RBD, and CephFS.
  • Design and operate storage performance management for high-throughput and latency-sensitive workloads.
  • Implement data protection strategies including ransomware protection and immutable snapshots.
  • Build storage observability across capacity, performance, and health dimensions, surfacing the signals operators need to spot capacity pressure, performance regressions, and failing components before users feel the impact.
  • Lead storage upgrades, firmware lifecycle management, and security patching across the storage estate, planning each campaign to maintain availability for the workloads dependent on the platform.
  • Drive storage cost optimization including deduplication, compression, and tiering strategies.
  • Troubleshoot complex storage issues spanning array, network, and host layers.
  • Stay current with storage industry developments and emerging platforms, regularly review release notes and community discussions, and translate noteworthy advances into concrete recommendations and adoption proposals for the team.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Five or more years of enterprise storage engineering experience.
  • Deep expertise in NetApp ONTAP or Pure Storage FlashArray/FlashBlade.
  • Hands-on experience with Ceph at production scale.
  • Strong understanding of SAN, NAS, and object storage protocols.
  • Experience with storage integration for VMware and Kubernetes (CSI).
  • Strong scripting and automation skills using Ansible, Terraform, or REST APIs.
  • Strong understanding of storage performance, capacity planning, and cost optimization.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across storage, network, and host layers.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Vendor certifications (NCDA, NCIE, Pure Storage certifications).
  • Experience with hybrid-cloud storage replication.
  • Familiarity with software-defined storage platforms beyond Ceph.
  • Experience with object storage at petabyte scale.
  • Exposure to AI/ML workloads with extreme I/O requirements.

For immediate consideration, please send your resume to jaya@bvteck.com or contact us at (908) 505-3545. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.

Overview

Thank you for considering IT Concepts dba Kentro, where innovation drives opportunity and collaboration leads to success. Our dynamic community of experts is fully committed to advancing our customers' missions, fostering professional growth, and making a positive impact on our communities.

By joining our supportive community, you will find that Kentro is dedicated to your personal and professional development. Together, we can drive meaningful change, spark innovation, and achieve extraordinary milestones.

Kentro is hiring a remote Staffing & Workforce Operations Lead to support our Veterans Affairs ESOM contract. The Staffing & Workforce Operations Lead supports the Workforce Management Lead by leading staffing visibility, workforce tracking, staffing action management, onboarding and clearance status coordination, and workforce readiness across the ESOM program. This role ensures approved staffing requirements are accurately tracked, coordinated, and monitored from demand identification through recruiting coordination, onboarding visibility, and resource start.

This role integrates and coordinates across those teams to ensure staffing needs are clearly defined, prioritized, and acted on quickly. By integrating directly with execution leads, the role helps confirm demand, clarify requirements, validate candidate alignment against approved labor categories, identify blockers early, and drive coordinated follow-through from requisition through onboarding. This integrated approach is intended to improve workforce visibility, reduce staffing cycle time, mitigate delays, and accelerate time-to-fill across the program.As the Workforce Management function grows, this role may oversee Workforce Coordinators, Staffing Analysts, Onboarding/Clearance Status Coordinators, or other workforce operations support resources.

Location: This position can be performed remotely within the United States and will support Eastern Time working hours.

Responsibilities

Workforce Operations Leadership

  • Lead day-to-day workforce operations tracking across ESOM workstreams.
  • Maintain the master workforce tracker, staffing action logs, vacancy tracking, onboarding status, clearance status, and resource assignment data.
  • Establish recurring staffing review rhythms, workforce update cadences, action item follow-up processes, and risk escalation routines.
  • Support development of repeatable workforce operations processes that can scale across ESOM and future programs.
  • Provide direction to future workforce coordinators, staffing analysts, or related support resources.

Staffing Coordination and Visibility

  • Maintain real-time visibility into staffing demand, staffing supply, vacancies, backfills, surge needs, resource transitions, and pending onboarding actions.
  • Coordinate with Talent Acquisition to track recruiting pipeline status for approved open positions.
  • Coordinate with the PMO to monitor onboarding and clearance progress.
  • Track resource-level information, including employer, project/workstream, labor category, clearance level, location, start date, and staffing status.
  • Identify delayed staffing actions, onboarding risks, clearance delays, workforce data gaps, and staffing execution risks.

Candidate Qualification and LCAT Alignment Support

  • Validate candidate qualifications against approved labor categories, role requirements, clearance requirements, and staffing needs.
  • Coordinate with the Intake Lead when approved labor category mappings require clarification or adjustment.
  • Identify candidate qualification gaps, LCAT alignment concerns, and risks that may affect staffing approval or customer acceptance.
  • Ensure staffing actions align with approved intake decisions, labor category mappings, and program staffing priorities.
  • Support staffing feasibility assessments for new or pending intake requests when requested.

Staffing Risk and Action Management

  • Lead staffing action management, including open action logs, issue trackers, aging actions, and escalation recommendations.
  • Support surge staffing, option year transitions, recompete staffing planning, backfill planning, and contract modification-related staffing impacts.
  • Prepare recurring staffing status updates for workforce governance meetings.
  • Support resource transition planning and workforce readiness reviews.
  • Escalate material staffing risks to the Workforce Management Lead with recommended actions.

Stakeholder Coordination

  • Coordinate information flow among the Workforce Management Lead, PMO, Talent Acquisition, project managers, partner/subcontractor representatives, and onboarding/security stakeholders.
  • Lead preparation of staffing review materials, staffing meeting notes, action item summaries, and follow-up documentation.
  • Document staffing decisions, dependencies, risks, and next steps.
  • Support leadership briefings related to staffing posture, workforce readiness, open actions, and staffing risk.

Reporting and Data Quality Support

  • Maintain accurate workforce source data in approved tools, spreadsheets, SharePoint, or other repositories.
  • Validate workforce tracker updates with PMO, project managers, Talent Acquisition, and partner points of contact.
  • Support reporting on open positions, time-to-fill, onboarding status, clearance status, staffing gaps, candidate pipeline status, and upcoming resource needs.
  • Provide workforce operations data to the Workforce Management Lead and other reporting stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Operations Management, Project Management, Information Technology, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • At least 8+ years of relevant experience in government contracting workforce coordination, staffing operations, PMO support, HR/recruiting coordination, program operations, or related fields.
  • Experience leading staffing tracking, workforce operations, resource coordination, or program support activities.
  • Strong understanding of staffing workflows, labor category alignment, onboarding dependencies, and workforce risk tracking.
  • Experience maintaining and improving trackers, staffing data, operational reports, or resource management data.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint skills.
  • Strong organizational, follow-up, stakeholder coordination, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to lead recurring meetings, manage action items, and escalate risks.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

 Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Experience supporting federal contracts or government programs.
  • Familiarity with SOWs, PWSs, labor categories, staffing requests, onboarding workflows, clearance processes, and subcontractor resource tracking.
  • Experience working with PMO, Talent Acquisition, HR, recruiting, program management, or security/onboarding teams.
  • Experience developing standard operating procedures, process workflows, governance routines, or staffing dashboards.
  • PMP, ITIL Foundation, SHRM, or other relevant certification.

Clearance Requirement:

  • US Citizen or Green card holder
  • Willing and able to obtain and maintain Public Trust Clearance
  • Must meet updated ID requirements: https://www.gsa.gov/technology/it-contract-vehicles-and-purchasing-programs/federal-credentialing-services/get-appointment-help/bring-required-documents
    • If you do not currently meet the ID requirements outlined, you must be willing and able to update your current forms of ID in a timely manner to complete the suitability process successfully.

Benefits

The Company

We believe in generating success collaboratively, enabling long-term mission success, and building trust for the next challenge. With you as our partner, let’s solve challenges, think innovatively, and maximize impact. As a valued member of our team, you have the unique opportunity to work in a diverse range of technology and business career paths, all while supporting our nation and delivering innovative technology solutions.
